input_contract: immutable book-level home/away moneyline prices from the same point-in-time market-capture-v2 batch
consensus_contract: median probability in logit space across at least two uniquely identified sportsbooks from one game/horizon/request timestamp

candidates.definition: normalize the two raw implied probabilities by their booksum
for exactly two outcomes, use the algebraically equivalent additive solution q_i - (booksum - 1)/2
candidates.interpretation_guard: do not treat the implied Shin parameter or transform as a direct measure of insiders, player news, or smart money

candidates.definition: solve alpha such that q_home^alpha + q_away^alpha = 1 and use q_i^alpha

scientific_notes: Strumbelj (2014), International Journal of Forecasting, DOI 10.1016/j.ijforecast.2014.02.008: margin-removal method and bookmaker identity can affect probability accuracy.
Whelan (2025), Scottish Journal of Political Economy, DOI 10.1111/sjpe.70017: caution against interpreting Shin-style distortion as a monotone measure of inside information.
For a two-outcome market, Shin and additive margin removal are algebraically equivalent; this is why the candidate is labeled SHIN2 rather than treated as a distinct insider-information estimator.
